description: Search the Physical AI dataset — real robot platforms (humanoids, quadrupeds, mobile manipulators, UGVs, drones), documented deployments with sources, the enterprise deployment guide, the autonomy taxonomy and the evidence methodology. Filter by type and taxonomy ids. Each result carries its evidence level, the sources behind it and what is NOT published (limitations); cite canonical_url. Use this for any question about robots, robotic platforms or real robotics deployments; use search_all when the question may also concern the rest of the corpus.

environments.description: Environment ids, e.g. industrial, warehouse, urban, offshore, underground-mining.

families.description: Taxonomy family ids: humanoid, mobile-manipulator, quadruped, ugv, uav.

locale.description: Language of the returned body. Default: en.

query.description: What you are looking for, e.g. 'quadruped inspection in industrial plants'.

sectors.description: Sector ids, e.g. inspection, logistics, security, manipulation, energy.

types.description: Restrict to these content types. Omit for all.

name: search_physical_ai
title: Search Physical AI platforms, deployments, guides and methodology
